name: Bai Chay Bridge
kicker: The span between the two shores
summary: Road bridge over Cửa Lục: cross Quốc lộ 18 between the shores, or see both pylons from the cable car. The span is the link from Bãi Cháy to Hồng Gai. Come in daylight when the photograph is the point, and keep both pylons in the frame. The cable-car fare is a separate ticket.
getThere: Quốc lộ 18, between Bai Chay and the Hong Gai shore
heroCaption: Both pylons and the deck at dusk

notice.title: No printed toll
notice.body: The toll is a separate question from the view. You also see the span from the Queen cable car as the cabin crosses Cửa Lục.

body: The bridge is the link between Bãi Cháy and the Hồng Gai shore. Quốc lộ 18 uses it. From the Queen cable car you look down on the span as you cross Cửa Lục.
Keep both pylons in view if you are here for the photograph. The deck carries Quốc lộ 18 between Bãi Cháy and Hồng Gai.

figures.caption: Both pylons and the deck, with a boat in front
figures.alt: Bai Chay Bridge across the water, both pylons visible

gettingThere: Quốc lộ 18, phường Bãi Cháy. Between the shores this is the road bridge.

legs.heading: Between the shores
legs.body: Quốc lộ 18, between Bãi Cháy and the Hồng Gai shore.

legs.heading: From the cable car
legs.body: The cabin crosses Cửa Lục from Ga Đại Dương to Ga Mặt Trời. The span is in that view. The ride is about 5 minutes in the 9 October 2026 article.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed.
admissionNote: The cable-car fares are a different ticket. See the Queen cable car for those prices.
